transcript_text:
[00:12] 7200703155341579793: hey, thanks for making the time. can you hear me okay?
[00:29] 3485800454521924007: yep all good. what time is it there for you? it's afternoon here.
[01:37] 7200703155341579793: perfect. so I'd love to hear what's going on on your side and what made you take the call. I know you're over in Netherlands.
[02:03] 3485800454521924007: sure. so we're Cogwheel, we're in the saas space. and yeah, we had a really bad outage last month that made it to the exec team, so now there's budget.
[02:53] 3485800454521924007: our monitoring bill is now our second biggest cloud line item and it's totally unpredictable.
[03:46] 7200703155341579793: that's a really common story. what are you using today?
[04:42] 3485800454521924007: right now it's mostly Newforge. and the agent config is a nightmare and the UI feels ten years old.
[05:30] 3485800454521924007: we've also looked at Grafalt and Datazen a bit.
[06:48] 7200703155341579793: got it. and is that something you're actively trying to fix?
[07:20] 3485800454521924007: we're tool-sprawled, everyone wants one place to look instead of jumping between five dashboards.
[07:51] 7200703155341579793: got it. and is that something you're actively trying to fix?
[08:43] 3485800454521924007: we've got a SOC 2 audit coming and we need longer log retention than we currently keep.
[09:30] 7200703155341579793: got it. and is that something you're actively trying to fix?
[10:25] 3485800454521924007: we've got like 80 microservices now and no real tracing, so debugging cross-service issues is guesswork.
[11:37] 3485800454521924007: at our log volume the current tool just falls over, queries time out constantly.
[12:28] 7200703155341579793: makes sense. when you picture this working well, what does that look like?
[12:48] 3485800454521924007: the fact that setup is supposedly quick matters a lot to us, we don't have spare cycles.
[13:38] 7200703155341579793: and what would hold you back from moving on this?
[14:15] 3485800454521924007: we got burned on a migration two years ago so people are nervous about doing it again.
[15:01] 3485800454521924007: we're mid-contract so there's a sunk-cost argument every time this comes up.
[15:42] 7200703155341579793: totally fair. let me show you how a couple of teams like yours handled exactly that.
[16:17] 3485800454521924007: yeah that'd be helpful. timeline-wise we'd want to move fast.
[17:19] 7200703155341579793: great — here's what I'd suggest as a next step.
[17:40] 3485800454521924007: works for me.
